description: Selected RU/EN short-landscape native-globe layouts reserve room while the companion is shown: the closed 240 × 96 px two-row dock reserves 252 px, and the open-help 144 × 96 px dock reserves 156 px. The 88 px avatar and 44 px controls retain their size; the help card remains an ordinary overlay. Bounded host CSS preserves established placement and rendering. Actual-App checks cover pet/navigation clearance with help open and closed, trusted-touch header controls and last-edition reachability after closing help, then full rail restoration after hiding the companion or returning to portrait, plus retained reduced-motion notice cases. Scene, saved progress and nonvisibility preferences remain exact; visibility changes are limited to explicit Show/Hide touches. Model, animation and renderer inputs remain unchanged; three D193 standalone photos retain their original scope through exact dependency hashes.
